name: Redo Romance
source:
Embark on a captivating journey in the enchanting world of "Redo Romance," a heartwarming game that weaves a tale of love, mystery, and self-discovery. Set against the backdrop of a picturesque, magical college, players will step into the shoes of a young protagonist navigating the delicate balance between the ordinary and the extraordinary.

As a potions major at the esteemed AGB school, you realize you want more than just academic success. Using your knowledge of magic, you decide to use a time-bending spell to explore all of your romance options. However, your journey takes an unexpected turn when you find yourself wrapped up in a mystery you have to solve.

Navigate the intricacies of the AGB as you encounter a diverse cast of charming characters, each with their own pasts, desires, and hidden truths. Forge bonds with captivating individuals, from the prankster at the pool to the intergalactic hottie who share your journey.

[Edited from [url=https://mrbowlman.itch.io/redo-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
